assertions.name: theta_measure_mechanism
assertions.source: exact polynomial identity m·k − m(m+1)/2 = k(k−1)/2 − j(j+1)/2 at m = j+k: the discrete measure with atoms q^m and weights ∝ q^{−m(m+1)/2} (equivalently 1/θ(q^m;q) up to θ(1), via RSZ eq (1.2) functional equation θ(qz) = qz·θ(z)) has k-th moments ∝ q^{k(k−1)/2} for ALL k — the RSZ Def-2.3.3 level-1 q-Borel weight is realized by a POSITIVE Jackson-style discrete kernel (RSZ §1.2.1 discrete-contour menu)

assertions.name: balanced_geometric_mean
assertions.source: N^bal(n)² = N_q(n)·N_{q⁻¹}(n) and N^bal(n) = q^{+(n−1)(n−2)/4}·[n−1]_{q⁻¹}! exactly (n = 1..8): the balanced normalizer is the geometric mean of the bar pair — the bar-symmetrized q-Borel weight, and the split used by the positive kernel construction (C4)

assertions.name: h2_coefficient_exact_match
assertions.source: log(N^bal_{e^h}(n)/(n−1)!) = c₂(n)·h² + O(h⁴) with h¹ AND h³ coefficients exactly 0 (bar-invariance ⇒ even in h) and c₂(n) EXACTLY equal (as rationals, n = 1..8) to Attack E's next-order falsifier target Σ_{k=1}^{n−1}(k²−1)/24 = (n−1)(n−2)(2n+3)/144 (closed form proved symbolically): the balanced confluence structure is verified through second order — MATCH (support, not proof)

assertions.name: confluence_rate_h2
assertions.source: max |slope − 2| over n = 3..8 (slopes 2.0000..2.0014): log-log fit of |N^bal_q(n)/(n−1)! − 1| vs h = ln q over q = 1+10^(−k), k = 1..6 (60 dps, exact product formula): slope in [1.9, 2.1] for every n = 3..8, and the extracted dev/h² at k = 6 matches the exact rational c₂(n) to < 1e-06 rel — the balanced moments converge to (n−1)! at rate O((ln q)²) with zero first order; n = 1, 2 deviations are exactly 0. The fitted exponent is a DIAGNOSTIC of the exactly-proved C2 series structure, not a fitted physics constant

assertions.name: pos_kernel_test
assertions.source: q = test (1.2…): the balanced moments factor exactly as N^bal(k+1) = [k]_{q⁻¹}!·q^{k(k−1)/4} (k = 0..8, rel < 1e−30) and BOTH factors are moments of manifestly positive measures — Jackson q-Gamma kernel at p = q⁻¹ (atoms p^m/(1−p), masses p^m·(p^{m+1};p)_∞ > 0) and the half-weight theta kernel at q̃ = √q (atoms q̃^j, masses ∝ 1/θ(q̃^j;q̃) > 0 by the RSZ eq-(1.2) triple product, every factor positive on the grid; log-normal continuous variant verified by quadrature, rel < 1e−28). Mellin convolution ⇒ an EXPLICIT positive kernel with exactly the balanced moments exists: (POS)∧(REP-balanced) is satisfiable at the fibre

assertions.name: fibre_indeterminacy
assertions.source: 0 = #violations of [Carleman-term ratio N^bal(k+1)^(−1/(2k)) step < q^(−1/16) = 0.98866958], observed max ratio 0.97737858 (k = 100..200). At q = 1.2: (i) the atomic realization K^at = Jackson ⊛ theta has strictly positive point masses (e.g. mass 8.5027918e-5 against the s = t₀ atom product) while K^ac = Jackson ⊛ log-normal is absolutely continuous — two DISTINCT positive measures with ALL balanced moments equal (exact factor identities): the balanced moment problem at q ≠ 1 is INDETERMINATE; (ii) consistently, the Carleman terms N^bal(k+1)^{−1/(2k)} decay geometrically (ratio < q^{−1/16} for k = 100..200) so Σ converges — Carleman's sufficient condition fails at the fibre. Determinacy ('moments ⇒ kernel', Attack A) is an ARCHIMEDEAN q → 1 feature only

assertions.name: cdf_confluence_diagnostic
assertions.source: 0 = #violations of [CDF deviation monotone ↓, < 1e−6 at q = 1.001, per-decade shrink in (50, 200)]; observed max dev at k = 3: 1.79e-08, shrink factors 91.6..98.9. CDF of the a.c. balanced kernel K^ac_q (Jackson ⊛ log-normal) at s ∈ {1/2, 1, 2} vs the classical 1 − e^{−s}: deviations shrink ×~100 per ladder decade — the kernel-level (CDF) confluence toward e^{−s}·ds is empirically O(h²) as well, matching the balanced moment rate (float64 LOSSY diagnostic only; the precise confluence statements are the exact/60-dps moment results C2-C4; the rigorous kernel-convergence theorem is the named remaining gap — Fréchet–Shohat + Carleman, outside RSZ per §1.1.3, literature route Di Vizio–Zhang 2009)

description: Attack B on the conjecture 'binding Borel variable = loop proper time' — balanced-kernel q→1 confluence + the (POS) hypothesis (bean qou-xa89, epic qou-q04o; audit-only, scope-(a), NO FIT, nothing wired). C1: the RSZ level-1 q-Borel theta weight q^{−m(m+1)/2} (Def 2.3.3 + eq (1.2), Astérisque 355) is realized by a positive Jackson-style discrete kernel (exact reindex identity); the balanced normalizer is the bar-geometric mean √(N_q·N_{q⁻¹}), exact. C2 (decisive): the h² coefficient of log(N^bal_{e^h}(n)/(n−1)!) EXACTLY equals Attack E's target Σ_{k=1}^{n−1}(k²−1)/24 = (n−1)(n−2)(2n+3)/144 for n = 1..8, with h¹ and h³ coefficients exactly 0 — MATCH: balanced confluence verified through second order. C3: ladder q = 1+10^{−k}, k = 1..6 confirms the O((ln q)²) rate (log-log slope in [1.9, 2.1], diagnostic exponent) and the numeric c₂ extraction matches the exact rationals to 1e−6. C4: (POS) at the fibre — the balanced moments factor exactly as [k]_{q⁻¹}!·q^{k(k−1)/4}, and BOTH factors are moments of manifestly positive kernels (Jackson q-Gamma at p = q⁻¹; the RSZ theta kernel at q̃ = √q, positive via the eq-(1.2) triple product; log-normal continuous variant): an explicit positive kernel with exactly the balanced moments EXISTS (verified at q = 1.2 and both q₀ pins, rel 1e−30). HONEST CONVERSE (C4e): atomic and a.c. realizations share ALL moments ⇒ the balanced moment problem at q ≠ 1 is INDETERMINATE (Carleman terms decay geometrically) — determinacy is an archimedean-only feature; at the fibre, moments do NOT pin the kernel. C5: CDF confluence trend toward e^{−s}·ds (float64 diagnostic). Remaining named gap: the rigorous kernel-convergence theorem (Fréchet–Shohat moment-convergence + Carleman determinacy of {k!}; explicitly outside RSZ per §1.1.3 — literature route Di Vizio–Zhang, Ann. Inst. Fourier 59 (2009) 347–392) plus the open (POS)+(REP) identification of the SUBSTRATE's kernel with one of the positive realizations. Nothing here proves the conjecture.
